title: Daily Workout · November 7
note: Recovery-focused 47-minute session after the prior interval day: comfortable walking, controlled upper-body and glute strength, and gentle core stability. No jogging today. Keep effort conversational and stop or modify any movement that causes groin, back, knee, or other discomfort.

items.name: Single lean-back quad stretch
items.instructions: Sit on the floor with one leg straight. Bend the other knee and place that foot beside your buttock, then slowly lean back with support. Repeat on the other side without forcing the position.

items.name: Butterfly stretch
items.instructions: Sit with the soles of your feet together. Let your knees relax outward and keep your back comfortably upright. Do not force your knees down.

items.name: Plow pose with feet suspended
items.instructions: Use your usual straight-leg variation with feet suspended overhead. Do not force a deeper position or turn your head. Stop if uncomfortable.

items.name: Brisk walk
items.instructions: Conversational effort, no jogging today. Slow down if needed.

items.name: Supported dumbbell rows
items.instructions: Support torso and keep spine neutral.

items.name: Dumbbell floor press
items.instructions: Moderate comfortable weight; exhale on press.

items.name: Bodyweight glute bridges
items.instructions: Controlled movement, avoid back arching and groin strain.

items.name: Bird dogs
items.instructions: Small range, steady hips, no back arching.

items.name: Dead bugs
items.instructions: Keep knees bent and shorten reach if uncomfortable.
